goal: Make exact-revision CI evidence discoverable and invite concrete merge-gate counterexamples without implying endorsement.
releaseGate: Written participant approval of the PythiaLabs × Ota attribution boundary.

en.hotQuestion: When CI replays code from another branch, fork or workflow, what exact identity and authority context must the result bind before it may influence a merge decision?
en.x: Two Windows fixes were green in a fork—and still NOT_RUN for the repository-owned gate. One temporary workflow bound literal SHAs, Windows runners, targeted commands, logs and final identity checks without moving either reviewed head. What must a green run bind before it may influence merge?
en.linkedin: A green CI result is not a property of code. It is a relationship between a subject revision, environment, command, evidence packet and decision authority. In this RESONANCE field note, two Windows-specific fixes move from HOLD / NOT_RUN to bounded PASS through a temporary repository-owned workflow—without changing either reviewed PR head or converting execution evidence into merge approval.
en.hackerNews: What Counts as Windows Proof? Exact-revision CI without moving reviewed PR heads
